description:
🏆 OBA McGregor Tournament 2026 Champions

Castmog Ladies FA are champions of the OBA McGregor Tournament 2026! 🏆

The victory is a result of the team’s hard work and ongoing preparation. We now turn our focus to early preparation for the Championship.

Congratulations to the team! 🟢🟡

May God continue to guide, protect and strengthen us. Amen. 🙏

**First Lady Tournament — Champions 🏆**

Castmog Ladies FC emerged **1st Place** at the First Lady Tournament, showcasing strong teamwork, determination, and competitive spirit throughout the tournament.
